---
title: "What aspect ratio and net glide ratio are achievable with an aeroelastically sized D-tube?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 189.7      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Execute aeroelastic sizing trade across tandem wing aspect ratios
trade = tandem_aeroelastic_sizing_trade()

m_root_base = float(trade["m_root_base"])
ld_base_mono = float(trade["ld_base_mono"])
v_ne_kmh = float(trade["v_ne_kmh"])
v_req_kmh = float(trade["v_req_kmh"])
v_req_factor = v_req_kmh / v_ne_kmh

# Unreinforced boundaries (1.5 mm skin)
b_unreinf_cert = float(trade["b_unreinf_cert"])
ar_unreinf_cert = float(trade["ar_unreinf_cert"])
ld_unreinf_cert = float(trade["ld_unreinf_cert"])

b_unreinf_vne = float(trade["b_unreinf_vne"])
ar_unreinf_vne = float(trade["ar_unreinf_vne"])
ld_unreinf_vne = float(trade["ld_unreinf_vne"])

# Honest boundaries with reinforced D-tube within 28.2 kN·m bending budget
b_honest_s = float(trade["b_honest_s"])
ar_honest_s = float(trade["ar_honest_s"])
ld_honest_s = float(trade["ld_honest_s"])
delta_ld_honest_s = float(trade["delta_ld_honest_s"])
dm_honest_s = float(trade["dm_honest_s"])
ts_honest_s = float(trade["ts_honest_s"])

b_honest_b = float(trade["b_honest_b"])
ar_honest_b = float(trade["ar_honest_b"])
ld_honest_b = float(trade["ld_honest_b"])
delta_ld_honest_b = float(trade["delta_ld_honest_b"])
dm_honest_b = float(trade["dm_honest_b"])
ts_honest_b = float(trade["ts_honest_b"])

t_skin_0 = 0.0015
t_skin_0_mm = t_skin_0 * 1000.0
rho_comp = 1550.0
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"AR {ar_honest_s:.1f}"`]{.hero-value}
[maximum achievable aspect ratio clearing the 280 km/h VNE divergence margin within bending budget]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Clearing the certification divergence margin requires thickening D-tube skin to [`{python} f"{ts_honest_s:.1f} mm"`]{.key}, adding [`{python} f"{dm_honest_s:.1f} kg"`]{.key} of composite mass (@fig-sizing-trade). Accounting for this mass under manoeuvre loads shrinks achievable span from [AR 94.8](2026-09-30-03-how-far-can-tandem-aspect-ratio-be-pushed-within-the-root-bending-budg.qmd) to [`{python} f"AR {ar_honest_s:.1f}"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{b_honest_s:.1f} m"`]{.key} span). At this limit, honest net glide ratio reaches [`{python} f"{ld_honest_s:.2f}"`]{.key}, beating the [baseline monoplane](../01-calibrated-discus-2c/2026-09-30-02-does-the-reconstructed-discus-2c-achieve-its-published-45-9-glide-rati.qmd) by [`{python} f"+{delta_ld_honest_s:.2f}"`]{.key} points. Without reinforcement, divergence directly limits aspect ratio to [`{python} f"AR {ar_unreinf_cert:.1f}"`]{.key}, with net glide falling to [`{python} f"{ld_unreinf_cert:.2f}"`]{.key}.

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **divergence margin: `{python} f"{v_req_factor:.2f}"` VNE**, certification clearance.
2. **composite density: `{python} f"{rho_comp:.0f} kg/m³"`**, carbon laminate.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-sizing-trade
#| fig-cap: "Achievable aspect ratio and best glide ratio under aeroelastic divergence sizing and +5.3g manoeuvre bending limits, with required D-tube skin thickness and mass penalty."
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.2))

# Subplot 1: Limit Root Bending Moment and D-tube Mass vs AR
color_m = "forestgreen"
color_mass = "purple"

ax1.plot(trade["ar"], trade["m_root_nom"], "--", color="gray", lw=1.5, label="Nominal manoeuvre ($M_{nom}$)")
ax1.plot(trade["ar"], trade["m_root_honest_s"], "-", color=color_m, lw=2.2, label="Honest manoeuvre ($M_{honest}$)")
ax1.axhline(m_root_base, color="steelblue", ls="--", lw=1.5, label=f"Baseline budget ({m_root_base:.1f} kN·m)")
ax1.axvline(ar_honest_s, color="crimson", ls=":", lw=1.6, label=f"Honest AR limit ({ar_honest_s:.1f})")
ax1.scatter([ar_honest_s], [m_root_base], color="crimson", s=50, zorder=5)

ax1.set_xlabel("Tandem Wing Aspect Ratio $b^2/S_{ref}$")
ax1.set_ylabel("Limit Root Bending Moment [kN·m]", color=color_m)
ax1.tick_params(axis="y", labelcolor=color_m)
ax1.set_title("Manoeuvre Load with Sized D-Tube")
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax1.legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=7.5)

ax1_t = ax1.twinx()
ax1_t.plot(trade["ar"], trade["dm_strip"], "-.", color=color_mass, lw=1.8, label="Added D-tube mass $\\Delta M$")
ax1_t.set_ylabel("Added Torsional Mass [kg]", color=color_mass)
ax1_t.tick_params(axis="y", labelcolor=color_mass)

# Subplot 2: Best Glide Ratio vs AR and Divergence Limits
ax2.plot(trade["ar"], trade["ld_arr"], "o-", color="darkorange", lw=2.0, label="Tandem best $L/D$")
ax2.axhline(ld_base_mono, color="steelblue", ls="--", lw=1.5, label=f"Baseline monoplane ({ld_base_mono:.1f})")

# Unreinforced limit marker
ax2.axvline(ar_unreinf_cert, color="navy", ls="--", lw=1.4, label=f"Unreinforced limit (AR {ar_unreinf_cert:.1f})")
ax2.scatter([ar_unreinf_cert], [ld_unreinf_cert], color="navy", s=50, zorder=5)

# Honest limit marker
ax2.axvline(ar_honest_s, color="crimson", ls=":", lw=1.6, label=f"Honest limit (AR {ar_honest_s:.1f}, L/D={ld_honest_s:.1f})")
ax2.scatter([ar_honest_s], [ld_honest_s], color="crimson", s=60, zorder=5)

ax2.set_xlabel("Tandem Wing Aspect Ratio $b^2/S_{ref}$")
ax2.set_ylabel("Best Glide Ratio $L/D$ [-]")
ax2.set_title("Honest Glide Performance Trade")
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax2.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=7.5)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
